decisions.reason: The formwork profile system builds directly on the firm’s existing formwork engineering and modular technology, so its absorptive capacity supports interpreting results and improving it.

Presented on its own page, this magnetic formwork component is close to existing formwork knowledge, enabling the firm to evaluate and enhance it reliably.
